meta.notes: A villager type: the look of the villagers of some biomes, as vanilla's plains, desert or taiga villagers. "biomes" lists biome ids and tags (#-prefixed); villagers born or spawned there get this type. The pictures in "textures" are drawn over the villager's skin and under its job's apron, 64 by 64 in the villager layout; they already sit where the game reads them (entity/villager/type/ and entity/zombie_villager/type/), so the game draws them with no code of the mod's. A type has no name and brings no trades of its own. It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its models, pictures and language keys.
